description: Run introspection query to enumerate all types, fields, and mutations. Sends the standard GraphQL introspection query (__schema) to discover the full API schema including hidden/undocumented fields, mutations, and types. Returns: {introspection_enabled, types: [{name, kind, fields: [str]}], mutations: [str], queries: [str]}. Side effects: Single POST request. Read-only.

url.description: GraphQL endpoint URL, e.g. https://target/graphql or https://target/api

name: graphql_introspect
